failures.evidence: The merge brought in main's 1b8d5c13 (#2269), which raised leasePoolSize from 9 to 10 (packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/store/pool.go:282 at 728b5e29). One server pod now opens 64 + 4 + 1 + 10 + 1 + 3 = 83 connections. The merged text still says 82 and the totals built on it: pool.go:162 ('82 in all', a few lines above the constants that sum to 83), dispatch.go:29, :32 ('82 x 6 is 492, so up to 5 replicas roll') and :77, README.md:200-201 ('82 in all', 'Six pods open 492, inside 500 with 8 to spare') and :233, and CHANGELOG.md:938 ('six app pods at the 82 connections'). At 83, six pods open 498. That leaves 2 of the 500, not 8. PostgreSQL reserves superuser_reserved_connections slots (default 3, postgresql.org/docs/16/runtime-config-connection.html) for superusers only, and Dispatch's Cloud SQL user is not a superuser [INFERENCE: Cloud SQL keeps that default]. If so, 5 replicas while rolling can exceed the slots Dispatch may use, and the claim 'up to 5 replicas roll inside 500' needs a recount, not only new digits. No red test: the defect is in comments and documents, and a test that reads source text is not allowed. The fix is to recount and rewrite those six places, and to decide whether the default tier or the stated replica bound changes.
